column4: As a Change Manager, I want AI-drafted impact scores per stakeholder group so I can build a stakeholder map faster than scoring every cohort manually.
column15: Core Module 5 capability gating publication on human confirmation (RULE-005).

column4: As a Change Manager, I want to score Awareness through Reinforcement per person or cohort so readiness is visible at both levels.
column15: Core Module 6 capability; feeds D06 KPI-001/002.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want an AI-suggested root-cause classification from a barrier description so triage is faster and more consistent.
column15: Core Module 11 capability, human-confirmed before closure tracking begins.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want the system to automatically flag when Knowledge/Ability are strong but Bridges still reads Ending, so hidden resistance doesn't slip through.
column15: Implements RULE-008 and Exception E2.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want an automated 60/90-day regression audit with an AI risk score, so regression is caught before it becomes visible in production metrics.
column15: Implements RULE-002; gates Refreeze confirmation.

column4: As a Super Admin, I want every AI suggestion visually labeled and blocked from taking effect until a human decides, so AI never silently changes a record of truth.
column15: Implements CTRL-006; foundational governance requirement across the whole AI Use Case Library.

column4: As an Organization Admin, I want to author a use case scoped to my Organization, with an approval workflow, so I can extend the library without waiting on a platform release.
column15: NEW capability per this design; requires an approval-workflow UI not present in the base spec.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want to propose a Project-scoped prompt override for a use case, so its output better fits my project's terminology, subject to approval.
column15: NEW capability per this design; needs diff-against-default and rollback (Superseded_By_Version).

column4: As a Super Admin, I want to edit role x capability permissions without a code deployment, so access policy can adapt to a client's org structure.
column15: Implements Section 3.4; every page-access/write/delete check reads from this grid at runtime.

column4: As a Super Admin, I want every score/state save on Modules 4,6,7,8,10,11,12,14 to require a justification, so the audit trail explains every change, not just records it.
column15: Implements Section 3.5 and RULE-010.

column4: As a Program/Project Manager, I want a Phase Gate to bundle Checklist completion, Readiness Index and open flags into one decision, so a phase can't advance on an incomplete picture.
column15: Implements RULE-013 and CTRL-012 (single-Accountable enforcement).

column4: As a Change Manager, I want to see and act on the charters governing my project (Sponsorship, Communication, Mentoring, etc.) with their concrete action mappings, so charter compliance is trackable, not just aspirational.
column15: NEW capability introducing D31/D31a/D31b/D31c into the platform.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want to see each persona's journey (Sponsor, End User, Champion) broken into touchpoints with success criteria, so I can audit whether the intended experience actually happened.
column15: Realizes D27/D28 (Stakeholder Journeys & Touchpoints).

column4: As a Super Admin, I want to manage a Group/Organization/Project hierarchy with cascading delete rules, so tenant boundaries stay clean as clients onboard and offboard.
column15: Implements Module 1 and CTRL-011 cascading delete integrity.

column4: As a Sponsor, I want a dashboard of journey-level KPIs (touchpoint completion, PDCA cadence adherence) alongside the existing Readiness dashboard, so I see the experience layer, not just the score layer.
column15: Realizes D29; extends D08 RPT-001 with a journey-specific view.

column4: As a Program/Project Manager, I want to seed a new project with the ERP 8-phase or Transformation-Types 7-phase template, so I don't build the WBS structure from a blank page every time.
column15: Realizes D32b; non-destructive merge onto any Change-Manager-edited tasks (CTRL-015).

column4: As a Program/Project Manager or Change Manager, I want a phase-specific readiness checklist for my own track, so phase-completion isn't just a schedule date.
column15: Realizes D32c; feeds the Checklist_Completion_Pct input to RULE-013 and every Phase Gate decision.

column4: As a Program/Project Manager and a Change Manager, I want our two inputs captured side by side on one Phase Gate decision with a single Accountable role, so the decision is fused, not two separate sign-offs.
column15: Realizes D32e; enforces CTRL-012 (single-Accountable) at the data-model level, not just the UI.

column4: As a Program/Project Manager, I want to import my PM-track tasks from our existing PMO tool as a CSV, so I don't hand-re-enter a schedule that already exists elsewhere.
column15: Realizes D32f; imported rows are tagged Source = Imported and remain editable, distinct from Manual entries.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want every WBS task tagged as belonging to the Project track, the Change track, or both, so I can filter the Gantt view to just my own accountability.
column15: Realizes the Project_Change_Joint_Tag field added to D09 OC-24 / D10 in this revision.

column4: As a PMO lead, I want to filter any module's data by the same P1-P7 lifecycle phase, so I can see a cross-module view of "everything in Testing & Training" regardless of which module owns the record.
column15: Realizes D32g; the Common_Lifecycle_Phase field added to D09 OC-24 / D10 in this revision is the first of several modules expected to carry this tag.

column4: As a Change Manager, I want to see the four ordered macro-process chains (E2E-01 to E2E-04) as first-class records, not just infer them from reading ten separate macro-process definitions.
column15: Realizes D32h.

column4: As a Sponsor evaluating a new initiative, I want to see how my transformation type compares to the other five on duration, terminal gate, external party involvement, framework weight, and reversibility, so I calibrate expectations correctly from day one.
column15: Realizes D32i; surfaces as a filterable view on the Module 15 dashboard.

column4: As a Super Admin, I want every record backed by durable, backed-up server-side storage rather than browser localStorage, so a cleared browser cache cannot silently destroy a customer's data.
column15: Realizes D32; this is the single most foundational requirement in this table — every other requirement assumes it.

Wave assignment: Wave 1 = core MVP (P0/P1 items on the D01-D10 backbone), Wave 2 = governance/orchestration extensions, Wave 3 = the AI extensibility/Charters/Journeys capabilities. REQ-016 through REQ-024 (NEW) close the WBS/Gantt, End-to-End Process Registry, Cross-Type Comparison, and Server-Side Persistence gaps identified against Functional Spec v1.3 Modules 18-19 and Section 2.4 — REQ-024 (Server-Side Persistence) is flagged P0 because every other requirement in this table silently assumes durable storage exists.
